entry.name: lessthaneq~
entry.digest: Is less than or equal to, comparison of two signals
entry.description: <=~ outputs a 1 signal when the left input is less-than or equal-to the right input and a 0 when it is less-than the right input. The right input can be a signal or a float.

arguments.name: initial-comparison-value
arguments.description: Sets an initial comparison value for the signal coming into the left inlet.is sent out if the signal is less than or equal to the argument; otherwise,is sent out. If a signal is connected to the right inlet, the argument is ignored. If no argument is present, and no signal is connected to the right inlet, the initial value isby default.

attributes.name: fuzzy
attributes.digest: Fuzzy floating-point comparison epsilon
attributes.description: When non-zero, an epsilon value to use for fuzzy floating-point comparison. Note that this isn't an absolute tolerance value, but is scaled to accommodate relative error for very large and very small values. The wordcan be used to denote the systemvalue.When zero (default), standard floating-point comparison is used, which may cause apparently equal numbers to not be detected as such.
